Owner asked for this on 2026-10-14. Keep it within an hour, and end with a pull request. The task is not done until the PR is open.

Scope: one commit on main of gongiskhan/ekoa-code, 575cabfa9 "Local drivers phase 2: driver-backed actions run through Cortex" (2026-10-13). It was pushed directly to main without a PR, so no PR review or PR checks ever saw it. Later commits (e46376dcb, 1b738171b, 927ee96d1) build on it and had their own reviews. Review only the code phase 2 introduced, as it stands on current main (it may have been changed since; review the current version). Do not review phases 3-5, the WhatsApp or the legal work.

Load the repo skills ekoa-architecture and ekoa-testing first. Check, in this order:

Egress chokepoint: no @anthropic-ai/* or api.anthropic.com outside api/src/llm/. Any Agent SDK or driver subprocess spawn carries no provider base URL other than the chokepoint's. Run scripts/chokepoint-grep.sh, npm run gate:judge and npm run gate:garrison.
Capability Contract (docs/CAPABILITY_CONTRACT.md):
Rule 3: no consumer special-casing, no branching on x-client.
Rule 4: every new capability route is AuthClass user-or-key and mounts requireUserOrApiKey.
Rule 5: new state is per-user scoped behind the path jail, with an isolation test.
Rule 7: new endpoints have zod schemas in shared/, contract tests, and schema/mount coverage entries.
Rule 1: no second implementation of an existing capability.
Convergence: no new noun where an existing type fits.
Import boundaries and module direction (lint zones, the tier table in docs/architecture.md).
Judge-selectable items (actions, integrations) carry a valid description (G1) and are registered via the registry only.
Tests travel with the module, and every new test file is in exactly one sub-suite in scripts/test-suites.mjs. Non-2xx bodies use the shared error envelope.
Diagrams in docs/diagrams/ and docs/decisions.md reflect the new flow.

Deliverable, one PR:

Fix the clear, low-risk breaks, each with the test it needs.
Log anything bigger or riskier in docs/findings.md (OPEN, readable slug, severity, owner, next step) instead of fixing it.
If nothing needs fixing, the PR adds the review record to docs/findings.md: commit, what was checked, result. The owner wants a PR either way.
Run npm run ci:lane, plus the sub-suites of the areas you change (likely integracoes, plus security if auth or tenancy is touched, plus platform for shared/), --unit unless the change is visible in the UI. Never run mobile, expensive or npm run test:all.
Do not touch api/src/whatsapp/archive-files.ts or api/src/archive/agent-tools.ts. Another branch is changing them.

Report: findings by severity with file:line, which you fixed and which you logged, the checks run with their results, and the PR link.
